notes: Claim-level acquisition queue. Located carrier material must not be treated as the complete primary object. Trump intent, Scavino knowledge, the alleged conversation, Ellis memory, the Fulton recording, and media recirculation remain separate branches.

items.record_class: complete Fulton County Ellis proffer audiovisual object, metadata, discovery identifier, and transcript
likely_custodians: Fulton County Superior Court discovery custodians
items.activation_effect: Determines exact surrounding context, qualifications, continuity, editing boundaries, and whether additional corroboration was supplied.

items.record_class: Ellis plea agreement, factual basis, plea-hearing transcript, cooperation and truthfulness terms
items.activation_effect: Allows exact treatment of truthfulness duties, use restrictions, breach standards, and admitted conduct instead of relying on media summaries.

items.record_class: December 19, 2020 White House Christmas-party event, guest, access, schedule, photo, video, and security records
items.activation_effect: Can corroborate presence and opportunity but cannot by itself prove the content of the conversation.

items.record_class: Ellis-Scavino messages, emails, call records, calendars, notes, and contemporaneous disclosures from December 11-20, 2020
likely_custodians: device and cloud service providers subject to lawful process
items.activation_effect: Could directly corroborate, qualify, or contradict the exchange and distinguish contemporaneous memory from later reconstruction.

items.record_class: Scavino testimony, depositions, interviews, messages, privilege logs, and explicit response to Ellis account
likely_custodians: House Select Committee January 6 records collection
affected_branches: whether statement was characterization or instruction
items.activation_effect: A sworn merits response or contemporaneous message could materially strengthen or weaken the central conversation node; silence alone has no admission value.

items.record_class: Trump-Scavino communications, meeting records, drafting records, and message-transmission records from December 11-20, 2020
likely_custodians: House Select Committee January 6 records collection
Trump and Scavino counsel or records custodians
items.activation_effect: Required to distinguish Scavino inference or rhetoric from a direct Trump instruction and to test whether any specific operational plan existed.

items.record_class: claim-level January 6 Committee transcripts, exhibits, and source citations concerning Scavino access and Trump post-election intent
items.activation_effect: Provides primary contextual corroboration and source-discovery paths but does not establish the Ellis-Scavino conversation.

items.record_class: direct Trump public statements and contemporaneous conduct from December 11-20, 2020
items.activation_effect: Can test contextual consistency while remaining insufficient alone to prove a private instruction transmitted through Scavino.

items.record_class: Ellis interviews, testimony, public statements, notes, and prior or later retellings of the party exchange
items.activation_effect: Allows comparison for additions, omissions, wording shifts, date shifts, and prior consistent or inconsistent statements.

items.record_class: original ABC, Washington Post, and AJC media files, transcripts, edit decision records, and publication metadata
likely_custodians: source counsel who supplied discovery excerpts
items.activation_effect: Preserves the carrier chain and identifies differences among the primary excerpt, reporter framing, headlines, and social-media captions.
